metadata.title: When It Comes To Oreos, Santa's Not Messing Around

content.text:
Competition for Santa Claus' sweettooth must be intensifying: Mondelez International is introducing the first new holiday ad for Oreo in five years.
Developed by NoNotes, the creative content studio founded by comedian and actor Colin Jost, it also shows off Saint Nick's vengeful side. Because the dad of the family took a few bites out of the Oreo cookiesleft for Santa, the big guy decides it's payback time. He takes bites out of Dad's stocking, new TV and even his remote.
"Get your own Oreo," he says. The ad is tagged"Stay playful."
The company says the spots are running on Amazon and streaming partners, Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, YouTube and connected TV.
In the campaignannouncement, Matt Foley, vice president of Oreo, says the brand "has always stood for joy and connection, and the holidays are an important opportunity to bring those qualities to life.We're putting our signature playful twist on the familiar tradition of leaving a cookie out for Santa, with humor and a little mischief."
Jost and No Notes have also partnered withactor Kate McKinnon to create ads for Zoom. Jost appears in ads for Blue Moon and Kay Jewelers.
The holiday spot isn't the only new thing to come from Oreo.
Earlier this year,Mondelez revealed ambitious growth plans for the megabrand, which brings in about $5 billion in revenue annually. It plans to extend the brand to reach more price points, spruce up the packaging andintroduce new formulas.
Luca Zaramella, Mondelez's executive vice president and chief operating officer, addressing Barclays Global Consumer Conference in September, said the move willconstitute a "full relaunch" for the brand. Oreo has been one of the company's standout performers, growing in the high single digits for the last five to 10 years, and -- even in amore challenging macro environment -- in the mid-single digits this year.
Oreo is the world's best-selling cookie, cranking out 60 billion a year. Chips Ahoy!, also owned by Mondelez, isthe second largest.
